### Shopware Version

6.7.8.2

### Affected area / extension

Platform(Default)

### Actual behaviour

You can assign a number range to a maximum of 25 sales channels; any additional channels will not appear in the dropdown.

### Expected behaviour

I expect that, when selecting sales channels in the number range, all sales channels are displayed.

### How to reproduce

- Create 26 sales channels.
- Add a number range under **Settings > General > Number ranges**.
- Try to assign all 26 sales channels to the number range.
